fullRoute: Trace values and branches, loops and lists, function calls and shared data, then debug against contracts and boundary tests. Predict before stepping through each activity.

escalation.text: For first-time programming instruction, follow CSC 242 and the free official Python tutorial sections. CSC 252 supplies the C++ language-specific behavior that this Python-based refresher does not teach.
